text.execution.userQuestionTool.init.1.zh-CN: 向当前用户提问并等待回答，可提供至多四个选项及说明，最多标记一个推荐选项。用户始终可以自由输入。仅在确实需要用户补充信息或作出选择时使用，不能代替业务操作审批，也不要重复询问已知信息。工具返回的是用户回答，之后继续处理原任务。
text.execution.userQuestionTool.init.1.en: Ask the current user a question and wait for an answer. Provide up to four options with descriptions, marking at most one as recommended. Users can always enter their own answer. Use this only when information or a decision is needed. It does not replace business operation approval, and known information must not be requested again. The tool returns the user's answer; continue the original task afterward.
